title: vitrob: Risk-of-Bias Assessment of In Vitro Experiments with VITROB
description: R package implementing VITROB, a result-level, algorithm-based risk-of-bias tool for in vitro experiments modelled on RoB 2 and ROBINS-I V2. It proposes domain and overall judgments, checks assessments for entry errors, draws traffic-light, summary, answer and reporting-gap plots, includes a point-and-click app, and verifies the judgment algorithms exhaustively against an independent implementation. Code: MIT licence. Tool content (questions, algorithms, template): CC BY 4.0.
